title: Schrödinger's 1944 What is Life? lectures on life's attraction to order

tellings.quote: Something Erwin Schrödinger himself theorized in his great 1944 lecture series, What is Life? And something that biologist Michael Levin at Tufts is discovering now, that biological cells have clear goals and intentions.

plain: The idea is that living things are drawn toward order and that cells act with goals and intentions. Michels says the physicist Erwin Schrödinger theorized this in his 1944 lecture series What is Life?, and that the biologist Michael Levin at Tufts University is finding it now, that "biological cells have clear goals and intentions." Michels offers this himself as part of an argument that purpose runs deep in nature.
